body:
Setting: in my living room, at home.
I am going to use JWH-018 as a point of reference, since it is (deservedly, to my knowledge) more popular than all the other JWH chemicals put together. I started with a dose of .01 gm., smoked. After 20 minutes, when this had a barely noticeable effect, I had another .01. The following day I smoked .04 gm, in four puffs separated by 10 minutes each. After 3 hours, I smoked another .05 gm. With JWH-018 this would have given me a real wallop.
However, the effect is quite muted compared to JWH-018. There is what I can only describe, imperfectly, as a bodily high, in which the intoxication seemed to be based somewhere other than my reasoning powers, which were unaffected. JWH-018, like THC, stimulates brainstorming and associations; JWH-200 did nothing of that. There was a very mild euphoria, together with a similarly mild enhancement of sensory experiences. In short, a light-weight, watercolor version of the experience with JWH-018. An orchestra deprived of all instruments save the viola and cello.
The peak was about 15 minutes after the dose; effects were mostly gone in 1 hour and completely gone in 3 hours. Like JWH-018, a resin is left in the pipe which is well worth smoking.
